# TowDaddy

> 24/7 professional towing and roadside assistance across Ontario. Safe flatbed towing, vehicle recovery, and emergency help. No hooks, just care.

TowDaddy serves Toronto, the GTA, and major Ontario cities with around-the-clock emergency towing, roadside assistance, motorcycle towing, long-distance towing, and vehicle recovery. Licensed, insured, and dispatched fast.

## Services

- [Emergency Towing](/services/emergency-towing): 24/7 emergency towing across Ontario.
- [Roadside Assistance](/services/roadside-assistance): Battery jumps, tire changes, lockouts, fuel delivery.
- [Vehicle Recovery](/services/vehicle-recovery): Safe recovery from accidents and off-road situations.
- [Long Distance Towing](/services/long-distance-towing): Inter-city and provincial long-haul towing.
- [Commercial Towing](/services/commercial-towing): Fleet and heavy-duty commercial towing.
- [Specialized Towing](/services/specialized-towing): Exotic, classic, and specialty vehicle transport.
- [Motorcycle Towing](/services/motorcycle-towing): Safe motorcycle transport on flatbeds.
